|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">ヤヴィンの戦いでウェッジが搭乗したＸウイング。デス・スターのトレンチにおける戦闘では、被弾して飛行用の精密機器を破壊されたため、ウェッジはやむなく帰還せざるを得なかった。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Red 2.

'''Card text:'''
May add 1 pilot and 1 piloting droid. If Wedge is piloting, immune to attrition less than 3. Without a pilot, power, maneuver, and hyperspeed cannot be used.

'''Lore:'''
Wedge's X-wing at the Battle of Yavin. In the Death Star trench battle it was hit and its precision flight instruments were destroyed, so Wedge had no choice but to return.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese lore names destroyed precision flight instruments and a forced return.
